leadText:
Assunta (Japanese: サユリ Sayuri) is a character of the day who appeared in Friends to the End. She battled Ritchie in the first Full Battle of the Indigo Plateau Conference. After a fierce battle, both s ended up with only one Pokémon left. Using her , Assunta was able to overpower Ritchie's , Sparky, and win the match, much to the shock of and . With this win she advanced to the semifinals.

It is unknown what happened to Assunta after this point, but the silhouette of the second-place League winner at the end of the episode greatly resembles her, indicating that she might have made it to the final battle but lost.
